answer: Because the entropy is measured at the juniper gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the relic audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 145 variations of one paragraph as a result pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the inlet panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 6 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning.
